headline: Executive order sets out a policy on how federal agencies should use artificial intelligence in a trustworthy way.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order deals with how federal government agencies use artificial intelligence (AI) in their own work. It promotes AI use that is described as trustworthy. No summary was provided, so the specific rules, requirements, and deadlines in the order are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: Agencies that use or plan to use AI would be expected to follow the order's approach to trustworthy AI.

who_it_affects.group: Members of the public who deal with federal agencies
who_it_affects.how: People whose services or cases are handled by government AI systems could be affected by how those systems are set up and used.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed December 3, 2020; specific effective dates or deadlines are not stated in the provided material.
